name: Staked USDS
oneLiner: stUSDS is Sky's risk-capital staking module over USDS funding SKY-backed borrowing; holders earn the stUSDS Rate and absorb shortfall and governance slashing.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The stUSDS contract is an ERC-4626 wrapper over USDS and has no privileged wrapper mint path; durable balance and freeze exposure therefore follows the reviewed USDS parent governance and token controls. A direct stUSDS holder blacklist is not established separately, so the variant is classified as inherited through mintAuthority.inheritedFrom.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: stUSDS is an ERC-4626 risk-capital wrapper over USDS; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable USDS mint authority is inherited from reviewed Sky governance controls.

controls.label: stUSDS ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573289, asset() returned USDS 0xdC035D45d973E3EC169d2276DDab16f1e407384F. The UUPS implementation slot resolved to 0x7A61B7adCFD493f7CF0F86dFCECB94b72c227F22 while the EIP-1967 admin and beacon slots were zero. Current wrapper shares are created against USDS deposits and do not create durable USDS supply.

controls.label: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority
controls.capDescription: The Sky governance executor is warded on the UUPS wrapper and can authorize an implementation that changes local share-mint logic after the Sky Pause delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573289, stUSDS.wards(0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB) returned 1. PauseProxy.owner() returned DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3, whose delay() returned 172800 seconds. The proxy reported UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0, and the pinned implementation source gates _authorizeUpgrade with the wards-based auth modifier.

upgradeability.controlRef: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20 at Ethereum block 25573289. asset() confirms that stUSDS wraps USDS. Its EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0x7a61b7adcfd493f7cf0f86dfcecb94b72c227f22 with zero external admin and beacon slots, and the proxy reports UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0. stUSDS.wards(Sky Pause Proxy 0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB) is 1; PauseProxy.owner() resolves to DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3, whose delay() is 172800 seconds. The pinned implementation source makes UUPS authorization wards-gated, so this delayed governance path can replace local logic; current public share minting remains USDS-deposit backed. No independent wrapper reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is established.

collateral: USDS supplied to Sky's stUSDS risk-capital module, where deposits fund SKY-backed borrowing and earn the stUSDS Rate; holders absorb staked-SKY loan shortfall and governance slashing risk
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 NAV shares over USDS; users deposit USDS to mint stUSDS and withdraw USDS subject to unutilized module liquidity, while bad debt or governance slashing can reduce redeemable value

oracleRisk.summary: stUSDS funds one live SKY-backed Lockstake branch. SKY/USD comes from a 13-feed-quorum Chronicle Scribe through Sky's one-hour OSM and a governance-set $0.025 cap. Unsafe positions use a Dutch auction when enabled, and auction shortfall directly reduces the stUSDS exchange rate; the live Clipper was fully stopped at the reviewed block.

branchApplicability.rationale: Sky's active chainlog and the live stUSDS, LockstakeEngine, Vat, Spot, Dog, and LockstakeClipper contracts resolve one stUSDS-funded collateral branch, LSEV2-SKY-A. The branch had positive normalized debt and a positive debt ceiling at finalized Ethereum block 25531413; no second stUSDS-funded collateral ilk was exposed.

branches.label: Sky LSEV2-SKY-A Lockstake branch
branches.summary: The sole stUSDS-funded branch values SKY with a Chronicle Scribe, one-hour Sky OSM, and $0.025 capped wrapper before Spot applies the 120% liquidation ratio. The nominal Dutch-auction path is immediate, but the current LockstakeClipper stop level disables kicks, resets, and purchases.

feeds.provider: Chronicle SKY/USD Scribe through Sky OSM and LockstakeCappedOsmWrapper
feeds.path: Chronicle 13-feed-quorum SKY/USD Scribe -> Sky one-hour OSM current/next values -> minimum with the governance $0.025 cap -> Spot safety price -> LSEV2-SKY-A collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: At finalized block 25531413, Chronicle Scribe 0xc2ffbbDCCF1466Eb8968a846179191cb881eCdff reported $0.061377729288013873 with quorum 13 and an age of 3,384 seconds. OSM 0x511485bBd96e7e3a056a8D1b84C5071071C52D6F exposed valid current and next values on a 3,600-second hop, while the Lockstake wrapper returned the lower $0.025 cap. There is no alternate provider. If the Scribe or OSM cannot supply a valid update, Spot retains its previously written safety price and can become stale; the wrapper itself only propagates OSM validity and applies the cap.

collateralParameters.note: Live Spot mat was 120%. Vat exposed approximately 134.97 million normalized debt shares, $156.10 million accrued debt, a $180.09 million branch debt ceiling, and a $30,000 debt floor at finalized block 25531413.

branches.liquidationMechanism: When enabled, permissionless Dog.bark immediately confiscates an unsafe LSEV2-SKY-A position and starts its LockstakeClipper descending-price SKY auction; the Clipper undelegates and unstakes SKY, sells it for USDS, and burns the configured exit-fee portion of leftovers. The live Clipper was at stop level 3 at the reviewed block, which disables new kicks, auction resets, and purchases, so the nominal liquidation path was not executable then.
branches.backstop: stUSDS is the segregated risk-capital backstop. The vault reported about $180.09 million of total assets against about $156.10 million of accrued Lockstake debt and zero debt currently in auction at finalized block 25531413. LockstakeClipper points its cuttee to the stUSDS vault; when an auction exhausts SKY before recovering original debt, it calls stUSDS.cut for the shortfall, transfers USDS into Vow, and reduces the stUSDS exchange rate.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Auction shortfall is socialized directly to stUSDS holders through cut(), which lowers chi and therefore redeemable USDS per share. Governance can zero the branch line to halt new Lockstake borrowing and can stop the Clipper; the reviewed implementation assumes Maker emergency shutdown cannot be triggered and requires any system shutdown to be orchestrated by governance. At the reviewed block the Clipper was fully stopped, branch debt remained positive, and no auction debt was active.

The exact direct exposure is therefore one protocol position with explicit credit, concentration, market, liquidity, and smart-contract risks.
